title: JogjaPulse: processing code and synthetic data
description: Processing, validation and figure code of the JogjaPulse aggregated mobility dataset for the Special Region of Yogyakarta, Indonesia (December 2021 to April 2022), with synthetic pings on which the whole pipeline runs on a laptop.
